requirements.text: Use one validated time-zone value contract in the account API and scheduler.

coverage_ledger.reason: The concrete contract is consumed by the independently verified API and scheduler slices.

tickets.title: Publish the time-zone value contract
tickets.outcome: The account API and scheduler can consume one validated time-zone value contract.
in_scope: Define and verify the shared validation contract.
out_of_scope: Adopt the contract in either consumer.
acceptance: Contract tests reject invalid IANA time zones.

tickets.title: Adopt the time-zone contract in the account API
tickets.outcome: The account API validates preferences through the shared contract.
in_scope: Replace API-local validation with the shared contract.
acceptance: The API accepts and rejects values through the shared contract.

tickets.title: Adopt the time-zone contract in the scheduler
tickets.outcome: The scheduler validates preferences through the shared contract.
in_scope: Replace scheduler-local validation with the shared contract.
acceptance: The scheduler accepts and rejects values through the shared contract.
